headline: Coverage changes confound 2 current signal
dek: The guard withholds a censorship interpretation when movement can be explained by a changing measurement base.

claims.statement: The current coverage audit marks 2 signal as confounded by its measurement coverage.

method.summary: for each signal with a recorded sample size: robust (MAD) z of the metric and of its denominator, then least-squares metric ~ a + b*denominator over the reference readings and the latest residual scored against reference residuals. CONFIRMED when the departure survives conditioning (>= 0.5 of the raw z and >= 2); COVERAGE_CONFOUNDED when it does not; INCONCLUSIVE when the fit cannot support either call

limitations: A coverage-confounded signal is inconclusive about substantive change, not evidence that no change occurred.
